verdict.rationale: Brex is a business banking and spend platform, so automated cash management is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents no auto top-up between accounts and no low-balance alerts. The business account with yield, the Payments API and generic webhooks are only adjacent or developer building blocks, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can automate cash management with auto top-up between accounts and low-balance alerts
